## Overview

Same-sample bidirectional MR in the Svenson DO HFD v12 cohort (n ≈ 763 for
calcium, n ≈ 835 for cholesterol). Both traits are rank-normalised; the
same individuals provide both GWAS, so 100% sample overlap correction is
required.

Co-primary methods:

- **MRBEE.IMRP.UV** — bias-corrected IVW estimating the overlap correlation
  (Rxy) from null SNPs in the GWAS data via `errorCov()`
- **IVW (overlap-corrected)** — first-order correction to numerator
  (covariance bias) and denominator (winner's curse); independent
  implementation for cross-check

MR-APSS results are read from `do_mr_apss_results.csv` when present (produced
by `do_mr_apss.R` on Great Lakes).

```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(MRBEE)    # remotes::install_github("noahlorinczcomi/MRBEE")
library(kableExtra)

# Files live alongside this QMD
DATA_DIR <- "."

P_THRESH <- 1e-5   # relax to 1e-5 if fewer than 3 instruments
WIND_MB  <- 1      # one top SNP per Mb window
MIN_F    <- 10
```

## Load GWAS summary statistics

```{r load}
read_gemma <- function(path, trait) {
  if (!file.exists(path))
    stop("File not found: ", path,
         "\nDownload from cluster: scp greatlakes:.../GEMMA/DO_HFD/output/",
         basename(path), " .")
  read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(.default = "d", rs = "c",
                                  allele1 = "c", allele0 = "c"),
           show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    rename(snp = rs, pos = ps, a1 = allele1, a0 = allele0, pval = p_wald) |>
    mutate(trait   = trait,
           chr_num = as.integer(str_extract(snp, "^[^_]+"))) |>
    filter(!is.na(beta), !is.na(se), se > 0)
}

chol <- read_gemma(file.path(DATA_DIR, "cholesterol_all.assoc.txt"), "cholesterol")
ca   <- read_gemma(file.path(DATA_DIR, "calcium2_all.assoc.txt"),    "calcium2")

harm <- inner_join(
  chol |> select(snp, chr_num, pos, a1, a0, af,
                 beta_chol = beta, se_chol = se, pval_chol = pval),
  ca   |> select(snp, beta_ca = beta, se_ca = se, pval_ca = pval),
  by = "snp"
) |>
  mutate(F_chol = (beta_chol / se_chol)^2,
         F_ca   = (beta_ca   / se_ca)^2)

tibble(
  Trait        = c("Cholesterol", "Calcium (19-wk)"),
  `GWAS SNPs`  = c(nrow(chol), nrow(ca)),
  `Harmonised` = nrow(harm)
)
```

## Rxy: overlap correlation from null SNPs

MRBEE estimates the error covariance from SNPs that are null for both traits.
For complete sample overlap this directly captures the phenotypic correlation
without needing the phenotype files.

```{r rxy}
Z_null <- harm |>
  filter(pval_chol > 0.05, pval_ca > 0.05) |>
  transmute(z_chol = beta_chol / se_chol,
            z_ca   = beta_ca   / se_ca) |>
  as.matrix()

Rxy <- tryCatch(
  as.matrix(MRBEE::errorCov(ZMatrix = Z_null)),
  error = function(e) {
    message("errorCov() failed: ", e$message, " — using cor(Z_null)")
    cor(Z_null, use = "complete.obs")
  }
)

cat("Rxy (error covariance matrix):\n")
print(round(Rxy, 4))
cat("\nOverlap correlation ρ =", round(Rxy[1, 2], 4), "\n")
```

## Instrument selection & Steiger filtering

One top SNP per `r WIND_MB` Mb window, p < `r P_THRESH`, F ≥ `r MIN_F`.
Steiger filter then removes instruments where the SNP explains more variance
in the *outcome* than the exposure (F_exposure ≤ F_outcome), which flags
potential reverse-causation instruments. Both traits are rank-normalised with
the same N, so F is proportional to R² and the comparison is direct.

```{r instruments}
select_instruments <- function(df, pval_col, f_col,
                               p_thresh = P_THRESH, wind_mb = WIND_MB,
                               min_f = MIN_F) {
  sig <- df |> filter(.data[[pval_col]] < p_thresh) |> arrange(.data[[pval_col]])
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    warning("No SNPs below p < ", p_thresh, ". Try relaxing P_THRESH to 1e-5.")
    return(sig[0, ])
  }
  kept <- list()
  while (nrow(sig) > 0) {
    top <- sig[1, ]
    kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- top
    sig <- sig |>
      filter(!(chr_num == top$chr_num & abs(pos - top$pos) < wind_mb * 1e6))
  }
  bind_rows(kept) |> filter(.data[[f_col]] >= min_f)
}

steiger_filter <- function(ivs, f_exp_col, f_out_col, label) {
  n_before <- nrow(ivs)
  ivs <- ivs |> filter(.data[[f_exp_col]] > .data[[f_out_col]])
  n_removed <- n_before - nrow(ivs)
  if (n_removed > 0)
    message(label, ": Steiger removed ", n_removed, " of ", n_before, " instruments")
  ivs
}

iv_chol_raw <- select_instruments(harm, "pval_chol", "F_chol")
iv_ca_raw   <- select_instruments(harm, "pval_ca",   "F_ca")

iv_chol <- steiger_filter(iv_chol_raw, "F_chol", "F_ca",   "cholesterol → calcium")
iv_ca   <- steiger_filter(iv_ca_raw,   "F_ca",   "F_chol", "calcium → cholesterol")

bind_rows(
  iv_chol_raw |> mutate(arm = "Cholesterol (pre-Steiger)",  F = F_chol, pval_iv = pval_chol),
  iv_chol     |> mutate(arm = "Cholesterol (post-Steiger)", F = F_chol, pval_iv = pval_chol),
  iv_ca_raw   |> mutate(arm = "Calcium (pre-Steiger)",      F = F_ca,   pval_iv = pval_ca),
  iv_ca       |> mutate(arm = "Calcium (post-Steiger)",     F = F_ca,   pval_iv = pval_ca)
) |>
  group_by(arm) |>
  summarise(n      = n(),
            mean_F = round(mean(F), 1),
            min_p  = signif(min(pval_iv), 2),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## MRBEE.IMRP.UV

```{r mrbee}
run_mrbee <- function(ivs, exp_beta, exp_se, out_beta, out_se, Rxy, label) {
  if (nrow(ivs) < 3) { warning(label, ": < 3 instruments"); return(NULL) }
  res <- tryCatch(
    MRBEE::MRBEE.IMRP.UV(
      by   = ivs[[out_beta]], bx   = ivs[[exp_beta]],
      byse = ivs[[out_se]],  bxse = ivs[[exp_se]],
      Rxy  = Rxy),
    error = function(e) { warning(label, ": ", e$message); NULL })
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  b  <- as.numeric(res$theta)[1]
  v  <- if (!is.null(res$vartheta)) res$vartheta else res$covtheta
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(v)[1])
  tibble(arm = label, method = "MRBEE.IMRP.UV",
         n_ivs = nrow(ivs),
         mean_F = round(mean((ivs[[exp_beta]] / ivs[[exp_se]])^2), 1),
         beta = b, se = se,
         pval = 2 * pnorm(abs(b / se), lower.tail = FALSE),
         n_pleiotropic = if (!is.null(res$delta))
                           sum(abs(as.numeric(res$delta)) > 1e-8) else NA_integer_)
}

r_mrbee_chol <- run_mrbee(iv_chol, "beta_chol", "se_chol", "beta_ca",   "se_ca",
                           Rxy, "cholesterol → calcium")
r_mrbee_ca   <- run_mrbee(iv_ca,   "beta_ca",   "se_ca",   "beta_chol", "se_chol",
                           Rxy, "calcium → cholesterol")
```

## Overlap-corrected IVW

```{r ivw-corrected}
run_ivw_corrected <- function(ivs, exp_beta, exp_se, out_beta, out_se,
                              Rxy, label) {
  if (nrow(ivs) < 2) return(NULL)
  bx <- ivs[[exp_beta]]; bxse <- ivs[[exp_se]]
  by <- ivs[[out_beta]]; byse <- ivs[[out_se]]
  rho <- Rxy[1, 2]; w <- 1 / byse^2
  num   <- sum(w * bx * by)  - rho * sum(w * bxse * byse)
  denom <- sum(w * bx^2)     - sum(w * bxse^2)
  if (denom <= 0) { warning(label, ": corrected denom ≤ 0"); return(NULL) }
  beta <- num / denom
  se   <- sqrt(sum(w * (by - beta * bx)^2) /
               ((length(bx) - 1) * sum(w * bx^2)))
  tibble(arm = label, method = "IVW (overlap-corrected)",
         n_ivs = length(bx),
         mean_F = round(mean((bx / bxse)^2), 1),
         beta = beta, se = se,
         pval = 2 * pnorm(abs(beta / se), lower.tail = FALSE),
         n_pleiotropic = NA_integer_)
}

r_ivw_chol <- run_ivw_corrected(iv_chol, "beta_chol", "se_chol",
                                 "beta_ca",   "se_ca",   Rxy, "cholesterol → calcium")
r_ivw_ca   <- run_ivw_corrected(iv_ca,   "beta_ca",   "se_ca",
                                 "beta_chol", "se_chol", Rxy, "calcium → cholesterol")
```

## Results

**Calcium → cholesterol direction** is not evaluable: fewer than 3 genetic
instruments for serum calcium survive p < `r P_THRESH` and Steiger filtering in
this cohort (n ≈ 763), precluding a reliable reverse-MR estimate. This reflects
the weaker genetic architecture of calcium relative to cholesterol in DO HFD
mice at this sample size, not a methodological failure.

**MR-APSS vs. MRBEE/IVW discrepancy (cholesterol → calcium):** MRBEE and
overlap-corrected IVW agree closely (β ≈ 0.0075) while MR-APSS gives a
near-null estimate with inflated SE. MR-APSS fits a mixture model (EM) to
separate pleiotropic from causal instruments and estimates pi0 (proportion
pleiotropic) from the instrument set itself. With only ~15 instruments the EM
is underpowered to distinguish real pleiotropy from sampling noise, and
previously estimated pi0 ≈ 0.40 (40% pleiotropic), which aggressively
down-weights the estimate toward zero and inflates variance. MRBEE corrects
for overlap bias via `errorCov()` without discarding instruments, making it
more reliable at this instrument count. We treat MRBEE and overlap-corrected
IVW as co-primary; MR-APSS is reported for transparency.

```{r results}
results <- bind_rows(r_mrbee_chol, r_ivw_chol, r_mrbee_ca, r_ivw_ca) |>
  mutate(ci_lo = beta - 1.96 * se, ci_hi = beta + 1.96 * se) |>
  relocate(arm, method, n_ivs, mean_F, beta, se, ci_lo, ci_hi, pval, n_pleiotropic)

results |>
  mutate(across(c(beta, se, ci_lo, ci_hi), \(x) round(x, 4)),
         pval = signif(pval, 3)) |>
  kbl(caption = "Bidirectional MR results (DO mice)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Save and combine with MR-APSS

```{r save}
write_csv(results, file.path(DATA_DIR, "do_bidirectional_mr_results.csv"))

write_csv(
  bind_rows(
    iv_chol |> mutate(arm = "cholesterol → calcium"),
    iv_ca   |> mutate(arm = "calcium → cholesterol")
  ),
  file.path(DATA_DIR, "do_bidirectional_mr_instruments.csv")
)

apss_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "do_mr_apss_results.csv")
if (file.exists(apss_path)) {
  apss <- read_csv(apss_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  plot_data <- bind_rows(results, apss) |> arrange(arm, method)
  write_csv(plot_data, file.path(DATA_DIR, "do_bidirectional_mr_all_methods.csv"))
  cat("Combined with MR-APSS → do_bidirectional_mr_all_methods.csv\n")
} else {
  plot_data <- results
  cat("do_mr_apss_results.csv not found — run do_mr_apss.R on the cluster,\n",
      "download here, then re-render.\n")
}
```

```{r combined-table}
plot_data |>
  select(arm, method, n_ivs, beta, se, pval) |>
  mutate(across(c(beta, se), \(x) round(x, 4)), pval = signif(pval, 3)) |>
  kbl(caption = if (file.exists(file.path(DATA_DIR, "do_mr_apss_results.csv")))
        "All methods combined" else "MRBEE + IVW results") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r forest}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Forest plot — bidirectional MR, DO mice (cholesterol → calcium only). The reverse direction (calcium → cholesterol) lacked sufficient genetic instruments after Steiger filtering and is not shown."

plot_data |>
  mutate(ci_lo = beta - 1.96 * se,
         ci_hi = beta + 1.96 * se,
         label = paste0(method, " (n=", n_ivs, ")"),
         label = fct_rev(fct_inorder(label))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = label, colour = arm)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~arm, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("cholesterol → calcium" = "#00274c",
                                  "calcium → cholesterol" = "#9a3324"),
                      guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Effect estimate (SD units, rank-normalised)",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Bidirectional MR: Cholesterol ↔ Calcium (DO mice)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
